5GNR_Connectivity.label: 5GNR Connectivity
5GNR_Connectivity.description: This is a device management object that should be used for 5G-NR capable devices.

Connectivity_Option.label: Connectivity Option
Connectivity_Option.description:
Indicates the connectivity option.
1 = Core Network: EPC; Master RAT: LTE; Secondary RAT: -
3 = Core Network: EPC; Master RAT: LTE; Secondary RAT: NR
2 = Core Network: 5GC; Master RAT: NR; Secondary RAT: -
4 = Core Network: 5GC; Master RAT: NR; Secondary RAT: eLTE
5 = Core Network: 5GC; Master RAT: eLTE; Secondary RAT: -
7 = Core Network: 5GC; Master RAT: eLTE; Secondary RAT: NR

NR_Band_Support_available.label: NR Band Support available
NR_Band_Support_available.description: Indicates the Operating NR Bands supported by UE in NSA mode. Value represents the integer value of band mentioned in 3GPP  Spec 38.104 (Table: Table 5.2-1 and Table 5.2-2)

NR_Band_attached.label: NR Band attached
NR_Band_attached.description: Indicates the Operating NR Bands on which UE is attached. Value represents the integer value of band mentioned in 3GPP  Spec 38.104 (Table: Table 5.2-1 and Table 5.2-2)

S-NSSAI.label: S-NSSAI
S-NSSAI.description:
Indicates the Single - Network Slice Selection Assistance Information for 5G Standalone mode
0 = eMBB
1 = URLLC
2 = MIoT
3 = Custom 
4-7 = Reserved

DNN_Name.label: DNN Name
DNN_Name.description: Data Network Name in case of Network Bearer Resource is a 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.

PDU_Session_Id.label: PDU Session Id
PDU_Session_Id.description: Indicates the PDU Session ID over which LwM2M session is established for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.

SSC_Mode.label: SSC Mode
SSC_Mode.description: Indicates the Session and Service Continuity mode for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.

PDU_Session_Type.label: PDU Session Type
PDU_Session_Type.description:
Indicates the type of PDU session over which LwM2M connection is established for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.
1 = IPv4
2 = IPv6
3 = IPv4v6
4 = Unstructured
5 = Ethernet
8 = Reserved (Spec Ref.)

5QI.label: 5QI
5QI.description:
Indicates the 5G QoS Identifier for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.
1-9,65,66,67,69,70,75,79,80,81,82,83,84,85 = Standard
128 to 254 = Operator specific 0,255 = Reserved 
Remaining = Spare (Spec Ref.)

SDAP_Enablement.label: SDAP Enablement
SDAP_Enablement.description:
Indicates whether SDAP is enabled or not for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.
0 = in UL only
1 = In DL Only
2 = In UL and DL both

QFI.label: QFI
QFI.description: Indicates the QoS Flow identifier for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network. (Spec Ref.)

Session_AMBR.label: Session AMBR
Session_AMBR.description: Indicates the Session Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate as per the 5G 3GPP Spec for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.  (Spec Ref.)

APN-AMBR.label: APN-AMBR
APN-AMBR.description: The Aggregate Maximum Bitrate which is applicable to a given APN over which LwM2M session is established for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.

NAS_Reflective_QOS.label: NAS Reflective QOS
NAS_Reflective_QOS.description:
Indicates the QoS at NAS layer  for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.
0 = Disabled
1 = Enabled

Access_Stratum_Reflective_QoS.label: Access Stratum Reflective QoS
Access_Stratum_Reflective_QoS.description:
Indicates the QoS for Access Stratum (RRC) for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network..
0 = Absent
1 = Present

P-CSCF_Address_Index.label: P-CSCF Address Index
P-CSCF_Address_Index.description: Index for the P-CSCF address for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.

PDU_session_Authentication.label: PDU session Authentication
PDU_session_Authentication.description:
Indicates the Authentication type for PDU Session
PDU session Authentication
0 = Primary
1 = Secondary
2 = Both

PLMN_ID.label: PLMN ID
PLMN_ID.description:
Indicates the PLMN ID over which UE is currently attached for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.
Allows server to see the currennt PLMN in string format (e.g. formatted as result of AT+COPS=? as per 3GPP-TS_27.007)

LADN_Support.label: LADN Support
LADN_Support.description:
Indicates whether LADN (Local Area Data Network) is supported or not for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.
0 = Not Supported
1 = Supported

Integrity_Protection_on_DRB.label: Integrity Protection on DRB
Integrity_Protection_on_DRB.description:
Current state of the Integrity Protection on Data Radio Bearer for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.
0 = Disabled
1 = Enabled with 64-Kbps
2 = Enabled with Peak Rate

Access_type_Preference.label: Access type Preference
Access_type_Preference.description:
Indicates the Access Type preference for 5G SA (FDD/TDD) Cellular Network.
0 = 3GPP
1 = Non-3GPP
